mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, title, content, type, related_id, is_read, priority) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{relatedId}, #{isRead}, #{priority})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
